description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page for editing wireless network configuration settings, including form handling, client-side validation, and embedded scripts for UI interactions.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi configuration parameters from external data source based on provided root and parameter list.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog for advanced security mode options, enabling user selections for security settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, serializes it into JSON, and posts to the server to save wireless configuration settings.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends a command to reset or restore WiFi settings to default on the device.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and quotes in strings for safe inclusion in JSON and JavaScript contexts.

methods.name: init_form
methods.description: Initializes the form UI based on current configuration values, adjusting available options and visual states.
